text:
sam.devex: quick check — streaming endpoint returns 401 only when running in docker-compose with the secret mounted. works fine when I export API_KEY locally. header printed is `Authorization: Basic <...>` but server rejects it. anyone seen docker secret files adding weird chars?

jia: how are you building the header? `SetBasicAuth` vs manual base64 matters. can you paste the exact snippet?

sam.devex: here's what I was doing in the container:

```
# entrypoint in compose mounts /run/secrets/api_key
API_KEY=$(cat /run/secrets/api_key)
AUTH="Basic $(echo -n \"$API_KEY\" | base64)"
curl -H "Authorization: $AUTH" https://staging.redwood.internal/stream
```

jia: two quick things: `echo` vs `echo -n` can add newline if you don't use -n (you used it here, so ok). but `cat` may include CRLF if the secret was created on Windows. run `xxd -g 1 /run/secrets/api_key` or `od -c` to inspect. also in bash `base64` might add a trailing newline depending on flags.

leo: fwiw in Go `req.SetBasicAuth(key, "")` will base64 encode `key:` (with the colon) per RFC. If your server expects `key` only (no colon) you can end up with a mismatch. Also if the file has `\r` or `\n` you'll encode those too.

marta: we've hit CRLF secrets before (windows CI wrote the file). `Get-Content` in pwsh can add `\r\n`. For quick checks: `tr -d '\r\n' < /run/secrets/api_key > /tmp/apikey.trim` then use that.

sam.devex: ran `xxd` and saw `0d 0a` at end — yep CRLF. fixed with `tr -d '\r\n'` and rebuilt the header: now stream works (no 401). thanks! :tada:

leo: nice. small note: if you use Go's `SetBasicAuth(key, "")` vs manually setting `Authorization: Basic $(echo -n "$key:" | base64)` the two are equivalent; just be consistent about colon and trimming.

jia: also for curl in scripts, prefer `-H "Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s' "$API_KEY" | base64)"` (printf avoids newline quirks).

sam.devex: sharing diff I applied in compose entrypoint: replaced `cat /run/secrets/api_key` with `printf '%s' "$(cat /run/secrets/api_key)" | tr -d '\r'` — seems stable.

dev-ops-bot: deploy-bot: rotated staging secret after fix (log: rotated api_key for svc/stream).

marta: great, adding a short note in the runbook about trimming CRLF in secrets and `printf` usage. :thumbsup:
